# Healthcare Analytics Cover Letter

I am excited to apply for the Healthcare Analytics role in Berlin. With 4 years of experience as a data analyst, I have built a strong foundation in SQL, Tableau, and cross-functional reporting, and I am eager to bring that experience to a team focused on improving healthcare outcomes through better data.

In my current and previous roles, I have supported business and operations teams by turning complex datasets into clear, actionable insights. I am particularly proud of work that improved reporting speed by streamlining SQL queries and simplifying recurring dashboards, which helped stakeholders access information faster and make decisions with greater confidence. I have also contributed to data quality improvements by identifying inconsistencies early, strengthening validation checks, and creating clearer documentation for recurring reports.

My Tableau skills have helped me design dashboards that are not only accurate but also easy for non-technical stakeholders to use. While my Python experience is basic, I use it where helpful for light data cleaning and analysis, and I am actively building on that skill set. Just as importantly, I value strong communication and enjoy partnering with stakeholders to clarify requirements, align on metrics, and translate findings into practical next steps.

I am especially drawn to healthcare analytics because of the opportunity to support better decisions in a sector where accuracy, speed, and trust matter deeply. I would welcome the chance to contribute my analytical skills, attention to detail, and collaborative approach to your team in Berlin.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my background can support your analytics goals.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
